name: llm-gw
changelog:
v10: the settings page follows the person's light or dark theme (D184, <html data-bx-theme="auto">), drawn from the workspace's tokens, fonts and 2px corners with drawn glyphs; its tables have 32px rows under a ruled header, a row's actions are quiet buttons, and the token column says set or none with its icon
v9: no change in behaviour — a test of the fairness limit checks the order calls were let in, not the order they returned (it failed now and then under load)
v8: usage by partition — calls from partitioned tiles are counted per person's partition (requests, tokens, cost; GET /stats callers: each person sees their own rows, the tile's managers each tile's people together and its global instance, the owner token every row without times), with an optional fairness limit on one partition's calls in flight (PUT /config partitionLimit, off by default; a call waits at most 20 s, then 429 with Retry-After); a tile that isn't partitioned is counted as before
v7: the settings page takes the workspace's thin themed scrollbars (D123)
v6: the page loads its script by relative URL, so it works under strict tile asset gating (--tile-assets=tokens) and wherever the tile is installed
v5: saving an API token from the tile's own settings page works — the page hands it to the backend, which writes its vault (a tile frontend can't reach the vault API, D30; it used to fail with 403); changing tokens needs write access to the tile
v4: token stats and cost count the Responses API (/v1/responses: input_tokens/output_tokens) as well as Chat Completions — the agent template talks to GPT-5/o-series models over it to show their reasoning
v3: response helpers come from the SDK (xbin.WriteJSON/WriteError)
v2: net:internet egress grant so upstream calls work under isolation
title: LLM Gateway
description: OpenAI-compatible LLM proxy. Configure a provider base URL, upstream token, and model aliases once; other tiles get a grant to call /v1/* (chat, embeddings, …) exactly like the OpenAI API. Works with OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, etc.
